notes.title: Update Notes 3.2.0
notes.notes:
With v3.2.0 we bring some great changes. Advanced mouse control, endless tower levels and additional rewards in the form of bonus upgrades for the towers.

General

 Bugfix for a campaign achievement


Multiplayer

 Bugfix for wave info synchronization


Game Interface

 Speed button always visible and controllable with the mouse


Towers

 Bonus upgrade for all towers added.
Can be unlocked if you defend a map on higher difficulty. If you have already done this in the past you get the upgrade immediately. 
Bonus:
	Medium	-> 	Bronze Upgrade:	+3% Damage, +2% Range
	Hard	->	Silver Upgrade:	+6% Damage, +4% Range
	Extreme	->	Gold Upgrade:	+9% Damage, +6% Range


Endless Mode

 No more limit for tower levels (only in endless mode)! You can upgrade tower on level 10 and higher (Excluded the special towers with percentage effects)


Graphic Options

 Bloom Effect Control added
(you can also change the Bloom in the ingame pause menu)


Mouse Controls

Camera Motion (Forward, Backward, Sideward) with the screen edges
The camera can be rotated with the right mouse button (hold down)
Press the middle mouse button to change the camera rotation. Pressing the button again changes the mode


Camera Rotation Modes

Camera rotates around itself (default)
Camera rotates around the center of the screen


Have fun

notes.title: Upcoming Update v3.1.4
notes.notes:
Hi guys, we are working on the next update v3.1.4. Here are some infos:

Bloom Effect Control
It is possible to adjust the power of the Bloom effect via a slider.

Advanced mouse control
It should now be possible to control the camera only with the mouse.

Camera Motion (Forward, Backward, Sideward) with the screen edges
The camera can be rotated with the right mouse button (hold down)
Press the middle mouse button to change the camera rotation. Pressing the button again changes the mode back
 
Camera Modes

Camera rotates around itself (default)
Camera rotates around the center of the screen (cool effect 😊)


Test Version
The update is uploaded as a trial on Steam. If you want to test it before the release and give us feedback, you can do this as follows:
Steam -> Library -> Right click on Towers of Altrac -> Properties -> Tab "Beta" -> Select v3.1.4_Test -> The game should list an update

The final release is planned for the end of the month.

Have fun
